I had one and it lasted a year and a half of heavy wear before the plastic around the charging port cracked. if I had really tried to glue it back together, it probably would've stuck… But I went and upgraded to the HR 2 and now my old HR sits on the shelf next to the FitBit One (which also needed a spot of superglue shortly before I upgraded), functional but replaced.

I never had any problems with day-to-day durability or sleep detection - though it would frequently misreport the jostling from a bumpy drive as physical activity.
